status: UNVERIFIED video proxies (2-D MediaPipe, ~30 fps feed screen recordings). Aggregates only (median/IQR over the clips_used of mason_keyframe_targets.json). Derived from Mason's Instagram swing references (aggregates only); Mason approved use of his own data (see docs/INSTAGRAM_DERIVED_MANIFEST.md).
handedness: left (native); lead arm = env left_* joints; env right_* = TRAIL (docs/HANDEDNESS.md)
role_mapping: Mason reference cols 0-3 (file names right_*) = anatomical right = LEAD arm for a left-hander -> env left_* ; ref col 4 (left_shoulder_pitch) = anatomical left = TRAIL shoulder -> env right_shoulder_pitch. Not interchangeable with the trail-arm targets in wrist_elbow_event_targets.json.
units: degrees in the reference convention (shoulder pitch: 0 = arm hanging, negative = raised; elbow/wrist: unsigned flexion/deviation); *_rad = deg converted, same convention

sign_conventions.env_wrist: positive env right_wrist = cocked (docs/WRIST_SIGN_MAPPING.md); that is the TRAIL wrist. Lead wrist has no env joint. Stored lead 'wrist' values are unsigned hand-deviation magnitudes (0 = straight line); the +1*ref - 1.31 rad offset in wrist_sign_mapping.json (tolerance 0.15 rad) was fitted to the TRAIL wrist's contact geometry and must NOT be applied to the lead wrist.
sign_conventions.shoulder_pitch: reference: negative = raised. Env sign of left_shoulder_pitch NOT verified here (env/ read-only, nothing run); use the sign/offset-invariant normalised form y=(q-q_addr)/(q_top-q_addr) as env._load_keyframes already does, or confirm the sign with a one-step FK check before using absolute degrees.
sign_conventions.elbow: reference unsigned flexion; env left_elbow range -10..150 deg, assumed flexion-positive (UNVERIFIED)

left_shoulder_pitch.env_status: ACTUATED in v3/v4_power (motor gear 40, forcerange 3.75; v3)

left_shoulder_roll.env_status: PASSIVE hinge (no motor; damping 0.5); readable from qpos, reward-only
left_shoulder_roll.role: excluded (low confidence video proxy; roll sign flips for left-handed env per docs/HANDEDNESS.md)

left_elbow.env_status: PASSIVE hinge (no motor; range -10..150 deg); readable from qpos, reward-only. Only follows if grip=True couples left_hand to right_wrist (default grip=False)

lead_wrist_derived.env_status: NO lead-wrist joint exists (left_hand is a 0.03 m sphere); reward-only DERIVED quantity (hand-deviation proxy), not computable from qpos without a defined construction
lead_wrist_derived.role: excluded; do NOT confuse with env right_wrist (trail) -- see docs/WRIST_SIGN_MAPPING.md

events.definition: median offset-corrected joint-axis event times of clips_used from event_offsets_s (joint-axis time, i.e. video-time event minus the ~0.4 s joint_axis_offset_s; do not reuse the uncorrected t_top)
events.caveat: Absolute seconds come from edited/possibly sped-up ~30 fps clips (0.48 s backswing is implausible); use PHASE (event-relative) indexing and the tempo-ratio band, not these seconds, as the timing target. NOT a speed target.
events.impact_note: landmark impact is EARLY vs hand low point by 0.067 s (+-0.05); detect sim impact as club-low-point minus 0.067 s
events.finish_note: finish = arm-speed settle heuristic; weak anchor
events.time_indexing: event/phase in SIMULATED time; reference dt 0.01 s vs env control dt 0.02 s (docs/REFSET_TIMING_AUDIT.md)

reward.form: r_lead = (1/K) * sum_{k in {top,impact,finish}} exp( - sum_j w_j * ((q_j(t_k) - mu_jk) / (s * sigma_jk))^2 / sum_j w_j ), weights from joints[*].weight; per-event gaussian in a window of +-0.06 s taking the best-matching sample (timing tolerance ~ +-1 frame at 30 fps)
reward.normalised_variant: for sign/offset robustness use y=(q-q_addr)/(q_top-q_addr) with sigma=sigma_deg/|top-addr| (same as env._load_keyframes)
reward.sigma: per-joint sigma_suggested_deg (max of MAD-sigma and the 8 deg floor); s curriculum 2.0 -> 1.0; s<1 not supported by the data

weights.note: lead-arm share of total tracking reward: suggest <= 0.3 of r_track since only 1 joint is actuated and the rest are proxies; weights are a judgment, not fitted

reward.wrist_command_lead: docs/WRIST_PD_LAG.md recommends leading the TRAIL wrist command by ~0.06 s (probe: lag ~0.12 rad at impact -> +0.003 at lead 0.06; sim only, v3 fs2). It was measured for right_wrist only. The lead shoulder pitch PD lag was NOT measured; consider the same lead as a hypothesis (UNVERIFIED) and measure with data/wrist_pd_lag_probe.py-style step test before adopting. Score angles at the applied-target time, not the post-step command (20 ms offset).

caveats: Aggregates over 7-8 clips, mostly down-the-line; view-dependent 2-D proxies.
impact keyframe has n=7 (one clip had no valid rows).
Lead elbow/roll are passive in the env, so the policy cannot directly control them; reward on them is only achievable via the grip coupling or body motion.
Instagram-derived: third-party content in source recordings never reviewed.
